info.title: Corporate Games AI gateway
info.description: One key-based API through which AI assistants organise and host Corporate Games. GENERATED from the games' own code: do not edit. Read /ai first. AI HAND-OVER RULE: BEFORE the game starts the AI does all the work for the organizer or host, except payment: create, settings, invites, announcements, status, clone and so on, within the routes the game already has. LIVE actions (start the game, pause, resume, stop, next number, draw now, approving or deciding a claim) are never pressed by the AI. The AI gives the organizer or host the exact page address (the game's own organizer or host page) and says in one plain sentence what to press and when. For a game run by the clock (Corporate Tambola, Bingo, Snakes and Ladders) there is no button to press: the AI says so honestly and gives the live game page to watch. It never invents a button. PAYMENT: the AI never pays. It may create and share the game's own payment link where the game allows it (the organizer's key, typed confirmation first). A person pays on the game's own payment page. Payment never goes through the home site. HUMAN-ONLY steps: the AI stops and hands over at publishing consent, at confirming a new Host's e-mail and mobile, and at anything that involves paying.

Shows the organizer's own sign-in keys: an id, the kind (organizer key, AI link, ...), whether it is retired, when it was made, and which one is being used right now. Never the keys themselves. Retiring or replacing a key is done by the organizer in the console.

Roles: organizer.

200.description: Envelope with state, result, allowed_next_actions, do_not, say_to_organizer

post.summary: Ask the game to e-mail the organizer a fresh 24-hour AI key
post.description:
The game e-mails the organizer a new AI work key that works for 24 hours (a safer key than the organizer key: it cannot pay, cancel, erase or manage keys and the team). The key goes to the organizer's e-mail ONLY: the AI never sees it. The organizer pastes it into the conversation themself.

Roles: organizer. Needs the person's confirmation: the first call answers 409 confirmation_required with the sentence to type.

200.description: Envelope with state, result, allowed_next_actions, do_not, say_to_organizer

confirm.description: Only after the person typed the sentence.

bearerAuth.description: The organizer key (ctk_...), the game's limited AI work key (cta_...) or the host key (cth_...). Passed to the game, never stored by the gateway.
